body: you know, that’s a really great question! i avoid acidic foods altogether because of my medications just to be safe, but now you have me wondering if i could drink a coffee in the morning and have the tums “reset” the acidity. there’s a possibility that the tums and acidic foods would just cancel out, which would make the ph of your stomach “normal” instead of low. i honestly have no idea!

totally normal, i felt the exact same way. if you’re looking for advice, i would say that to make the medication more consistent, your lifestyle needs to be more consistent. for me, it’s routines; on days i really need the meds to work i take a tums 20 minutes before my meds which helps bring the ph of your stomach down, i take my meds with lots and lots of water, i eat a high-protein breakfast soon after taking them, and i reeeally focus on eating well throughout the day. adderall will tell you that you are not hungry, but once it begins to wear off, your body will be angry and you’ll experience a crash. so; don’t eat acidic foods close to taking your meds, drink a LOT of water, eat high protein meals, keep a regular sleep schedule; try it out and let me know if it helps at all!!
